_comment: Round 3 tone check (docs/VOICE_ASSISTANT.md Q20): the 10 most telling lines from tone-lines.json (8 that had errors in round 2, plus 得 děi and one mixed line). 'pinyin' is the expected reading shown to the listener. 'hint' is one syllable per Han character, fed to Google's <phoneme> hints via TTSService → buildPinyinSsml (the same path the flashcards use). 一/不 carry their spoken tones; third tones are written as citation tones.

lines.text: "Deadline" 可以说"截止日期"，比如：这个项目的截止日期是星期五。
lines.pinyin: "Deadline" kěyǐ shuō "jiézhǐ rìqī", bǐrú: zhège xiàngmù de jiézhǐ rìqī shì xīngqīwǔ.
lines.hint: kě yǐ shuō jié zhǐ rì qī bǐ rú zhè ge xiàng mù de jié zhǐ rì qī shì xīng qī wǔ

lines.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ děi zǒu le.
lines.hint: bù hǎo yì si wǒ děi zǒu le

lines.text: 这个项目的截止日期是星期五。
lines.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù de jiézhǐ rìqī shì xīngqīwǔ.
lines.hint: zhè ge xiàng mù de jié zhǐ rì qī shì xīng qī wǔ

lines.text: 我觉得这家饭馆的菜特别好吃。
lines.pinyin: wǒ juéde zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài tèbié hǎochī.
lines.hint: wǒ jué de zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài tè bié hǎo chī

lines.text: 下雨天我喜欢在家看书。
lines.pinyin: xiàyǔ tiān wǒ xǐhuan zài jiā kàn shū.
lines.hint: xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā kàn shū

lines.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn, hǎo ma?
lines.hint: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn hǎo ma

lines.text: 这个周末天气预报说会下雪。
lines.pinyin: zhège zhōumò tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xià xuě.
lines.hint: zhè ge zhōu mò tiān qì yù bào shuō huì xià xuě

lines.text: 我们公司明年要搬到上海。
lines.pinyin: wǒmen gōngsī míngnián yào bān dào Shànghǎi.
lines.hint: wǒ men gōng sī míng nián yào bān dào shàng hǎi

lines.text: 你可以用"因为……所以……"造一个句子吗？
lines.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ yòng "yīnwèi… suǒyǐ…" zào yí gè jùzi ma?
lines.hint: nǐ kě yǐ yòng yīn wèi suǒ yǐ zào yí gè jù zi ma

lines.text: "Meeting" 就是"会议"，比如：我下午有一个会议。
lines.pinyin: "Meeting" jiù shì "huìyì", bǐrú: wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu yí gè huìyì.
lines.hint: jiù shì huì yì bǐ rú wǒ xià wǔ yǒu yí gè huì yì
